digest.component_or_area: Cloud outbound comment differ and send path
propositions: The differ's comment comparison key is fitted with comment_limits.truncate_comment_body (plain 32,767-char cap) while the Cloud send path fits with AdfCodec.fit_outbound (serialized ADF against 32,000-char limit), causing over-length comments to never match in body-equality dedup
With a 43,200-char body, the comparison key yields 32,767 characters but the send path lands 31,753 characters, with first divergence at index 31,725, proving the two paths cannot converge

The regression was introduced by commit 27b868ba55 (emersed-specific-mutt) which moved the send path off the shared helper while leaving the differ on it, and can be confirmed by re-running both transforms at that commit's parent where both yielded identical 32,767-char results

The fix restores the invariant by making _JiraSanitizer.fit_comment return fit_comment_as_sent(body, AdfCodec.fit_outbound) instead of truncate_comment_body, ensuring the differ key exactly matches the text the send path lands
The dedup key is computed in-memory each pass and never persisted, so the fix cannot trigger re-posts; every case where the old key matched the landed body, the new key also matches it
